description: The Cursor Composer preset was hidden until the user first changed Provider type to OpenAI-compatible.
expected: A user who wants Cursor Composer can use the preset directly from the New Inference Profile dialog.
actual: The shortcut was gated behind the provider dropdown, adding friction and making the path brittle when the dropdown is hard to interact with.
suggested_fix: Show the Cursor Composer preset before provider selection and have it set the provider, base URL, and model IDs.
